risks.title: Dependence on a few large customers
risks.score_rationale: Risk highlighted with quantified data (49.1% of sales in 2025). Strong language: 'seriously harm', 'loss of customers or market share'. Customer concentration stable but critical. High weighting for Competition category.

risks.title: Increased margin pressure from competition
risks.score_rationale: Document describes strong competitive pressure, notably on pricing and margins. Explicit language: 'significant price reduction', 'loss of market share'. Recurring risk, no marked deterioration vs. prior year.

risks.title: Customer demand volatility
risks.score_rationale: Central position in 10-K, with mention of external factors (inflation, conflicts). Alarming language: 'seriously harm', 'strained resources'. Risk amplified by absence of firm commitments. Industrial category heavily weighted.

risks.title: Strict sector regulations
risks.score_rationale: Focus on FDA, defense, healthcare with risk of severe sanctions. Strong language: 'total or partial production suspension', 'reputational damage'. Regulatory environment in continuous reinforcement. Regulation category highly critical.

risks.title: Geopolitical risks in Asia
risks.score_rationale: Explicit mention of China-Taiwan tensions, China-US tensions, Malaysia concentration. Concerned language: 'escalation risk', 'disruptions'. Risk increasing with current context. Geopolitical category moderately weighted.

risks.title: Acquisition integration difficulties
risks.score_rationale: Major strategic risk linked to external growth. Clear language on financial and operational risks: 'management diversion', 'significant write-downs'. Repeated mention, but no sign of aggravation. Capital category moderately weighted.

risks.title: Component shortages and supply chain management
risks.score_rationale: Risk linked to demand volatility and structural shortages. Language: 'amplifies difficulties', 'increased cost'. Persistent supply chain tension context. Industrial category heavily weighted.

ai_positioning.summary: PLXS does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 10-K/20-F filing.
